items.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

source_prefix.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

inverse_prefix.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

leading_parameters.description: When absent, require a unique inverse formed by a leading parameter count accepted by the locked inverse signature

inverse_alternatives.description: Pairs of enum alternative values of one signature that are each other's inverse (on/off, enable/disable); decided on the locked tree's declared enum structure, never on free text

family.description: which of the product names the build carries

line.description: version line the pack assigns to the build, for example 10.7.6

base.description: the build whose tree this build uses; equals name when the build has its own tree

platform.description: platform or customer branch; null for the main platform

list.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON array of the listed external ids, as listed: the object that holds them

sources.description: external objects by role; a role that holds a list is kept by reference

build.description: the build the root was produced for, as the sync listed it (list roles by reference)

artifact.description: digest of the source_artifact record that decided the read

sources.description: every source; with parts, the sources of single slots only (the list sources are in parts.sources)

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

producers.description: the producers of the product pack that gave the entry, sorted; a catalog limited to one producer takes only its entries

fragments.description: canonical src references in the order the producers gave them

inherited.description: Inherited field codes only; source positions belong to composition provenance

superseded.description: An inner scope replaced this declaration; retained as provenance only

decided_by.description: who decided the source belongs to the version: the product pack id@version

placement.description: present when the typed-judgment model chose the position

p.description: probability of the last choice that descended

threshold.description: the calibrated threshold of the chain

note.description: 归类判断：Jev@<exact version>，p=…，只影响位置

composition.description: sorted by path, then entry; empty when the rows are in parts

producers.description: the producers of the product pack that gave the entry, sorted; a catalog limited to one producer takes only its entries

fragments.description: every source piece with this content, in the order the producers gave them

inherited.description: Inherited field codes only; source positions belong to composition provenance

superseded.description: An inner scope replaced this declaration; retained as provenance only

stopped_at.description: the node where placement stopped (/ when it never descended)

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

calibrated.description: false: the chain has no calibrated threshold, the answer is only a candidate

candidate.description: the model's answer kept as a candidate, when it named a child

unplaced.description: sorted by entry; empty when the rows are in parts

parts.description: a large composition keeps its rows, unplaced rows and list sources in part records, so that no record grows with the root

first.description: sort key of the first row: the path (composition rows), the entry digest (unplaced rows) or the source digest (sources)

last.description: sort key of the last row

kind.description: the kind of every row of the part

first.description: sort key of the first row: the path (composition rows), the entry digest (unplaced rows) or the source digest (sources)

last.description: sort key of the last row

first.description: sort key of the first row: the path (composition rows), the entry digest (unplaced rows) or the source digest (sources)

last.description: sort key of the last row

sources.description: tree_root-sources@1 records: the sources of list slots

unplaced.description: the refused item was an unplaced span rather than an entry

kind.description: the kind the producer declared, as given (cut to 200 characters; may be empty or outside entry_kind)

skipped.description: listed sources the production could not use (first 200 kept)

id.description: catalog@major, the name workflow packs require

entry_kind.description: kind of the knowledge entries that are its members

producer.description: only entries this producer of the pack produced are members; every producer of the kind when absent

complete.description: declared complete for the scope of the root (C07 R[0]); only then is absence a fact rather than unknown

links.description: frozen relation declarations of this composition; absent on legacy records

field.description: Data field holding ordinary literals; mutually exclusive with alternatives_field

alternatives_field.description: Data field holding groups {primary: string, alternatives: nonempty string[]}; exact primary definition wins, otherwise each alternative is matched exactly

namespace.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

entry_kind.description: required by longest-prefix matching; optional restriction for exact matching

unmatched.description: What a literal this rule cannot match is: drift, a fact of the run (default), or mention, the author's marked text kept verbatim and linked only on complete equality (integrator decision 60, 2026-10-25: prose claims no command, so it creates no drift)

empty_scope.description: An empty product-wide root with independently checked complete inventories and zero selections; absent on legacy or nonempty roots
